correctness.rationale: For d>=2 the signed generators Gamma_j square to I and anticommute, hence H0²=dI and Tr(H0)=0. The four vectors p,q,H0p,H0q for each weakened edge have Gram determinant (d-1)²>0; induced-matching endpoint separation makes different 4D invariant subspaces orthogonal. In a fixed 4D sector the characteristic polynomial is (z²+alpha*z+alpha-d)(z²-alpha*z+alpha-d), yielding energies ±L±(alpha), and each unperturbed ±sqrt(d) retains multiplicity 2^(d-1)-2k. Dynamic support follows from invariant spans of the two endpoint stars, size exactly 2d. Direct independently constructed Hamiltonians checked H0²=dI and the eigenvalue multiset in d=2..6; the all-d assertion rests on Clifford algebra/invariance, not finite numerics.

evidence: Aharonov–Bohm cages already occur in frustrated dice/planar tilings and disorder can disrupt those cages; no general all-d induced-matching bond-defect multiset follows from the inspected models.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A universal compact-localized-state defect theorem might cover the cage decomposition, but no such stronger matching-specific eigenvalue statement was identified.
